description: Combine weighted course parts into the grade so far, plus the worst and best possible finish. Inputs: parts (each with a name, a weight that is a percentage of the whole course greater than 0, and an optional score between 0 and 100; leave the score out for parts that are not marked yet). A weight is a percentage of the whole course, so the parts are never rescaled. Parts that add up to less than 100 leave the rest of the course still to come, and weights that add up to more than 100 are an error. Example prompt: "My course is 20% quizzes, 30% labs, 50% exam. I have 85 on quizzes and 70 on labs. What's my grade so far and what's the best I can finish with?"

parts.description: The weighted parts of the course. Each needs a name and a weight (a percentage of the whole course greater than 0); score is 0 to 100, or leave it out for parts that are not marked yet. Weights are percentages of the whole course, so parts that add up to less than 100 leave the rest of the course still to come.

score.description: Score between 0 and 100 for marked parts, or leave out for unmarked parts.

weight.description: Weight as a percentage of the whole course, greater than 0.

name: weighted_grade

best_finish.description: The course grade if every remaining part scores 100.

current_grade.description: The average on the marked work, or null when nothing is marked yet.

done_weight.description: The weight of the marked parts, as a percentage of the whole course.

earned_points.description: The points already banked out of the 100 the whole course is worth.

parts.description: One entry per part, in the order they were passed.

score.description: Score on the part, or null when the part is not marked yet.

weight.description: Weight of the part as a percentage of the whole course.

remaining_weight.description: The weight of the course that is still to come, as a percentage of the whole course.

total_weight.description: The weights of the parts added together, as a percentage of the whole course.

worst_finish.description: The course grade if every remaining part scores 0.

title: Weighted grade
